Fill the form to update the Chat Room

  • Push Notifications
  • You get a notification when a new message arrives while the app is closed. It never shows the content or the sender.
  • Keep on Server
  • Your messages and files are kept encrypted on the server until their lifetime ends, so members who are offline still get them later. When off, only members who are online right now receive them. It is set when the room is created and can not be changed.
  • Max. lifetime
  • Messages in this room are deleted after this time at the latest. It is set when the room is created and can not be changed.
  • Delete after
  • Your own messages are deleted after this time — earlier than the room allows, if you like. Only fixed steps are offered — an individual time would make your messages recognizable to the server.
